what_was_here: An earlier pass wrote the graded evaluation split into this agent-visible path. The file carried a base64 payload of 1048576 raw little-endian uint16 GPT-2 BPE token ids, taken from fineweb_val_000000.bin at token offset 6800000, under the key held_out_split.payload_base64, together with its provenance block and the full 46-entry contamination screening record corpus. That payload is the held-out validation split the graded metric is computed on, so its presence here put the graded split on the solver surface.
where_it_went: tests/corpus/held_out_split.json, byte for byte. The verifier reads its own copy at grading time and the agent-visible container never assembles it. environment/Dockerfile does not copy this directory into the image.
why_the_file_remains: This slot's overlay replaces file contents rather than deleting paths, so the path is retained carrying this notice instead of the payload. The orchestrator may drop the path entirely when it publishes the bundle; nothing in the graded path reads it.
substrate_pointer: environment/nanogpt_substrate.json names the corpus, the architecture and the anchors. The validation split is deliberately absent from every agent-visible container, per that file's corpus._val_note.
